feedback: The dashboard is much faster and the export button is easy to find.
Support took three days to answer our ticket and the reply did not solve the billing issue.
I love the new onboarding checklist, but permissions are still confusing for admins.
The mobile view is broken on our team's Android devices.
Pricing feels expensive now that we need more seats.
Search is fast and accurate. It saves our support team time every week.
Reports sometimes fail to load on Monday mornings.
The new chat handoff feature is excellent for urgent cases.
We need clearer invoices and fewer billing surprises.
The product is good overall, but advanced filters are hard to understand.
